case_brief.subject: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
aliases: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
case_brief.what_it_is: PM Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana is a government employment incentive scheme designed to boost youth employment and formalization of the workforce. It provides direct benefit support to newly employed first-time employees and financial incentives to employers for creating new jobs.
case_brief.entitlement: Eligible first-time employees receive an incentive of Rs. 15,000 in two instalments (the 1st instalment payable after 6 months of service and the 2nd instalment payable after 12 months of service).
conditions: The employee must be a newly registered EPFO member.
The employee must have a salary up to Rs 1 lakh.
The employee must complete 6 months of service for the 1st instalment.
The employee must complete 12 months of service for the 2nd instalment.
common_failure_reasons: Aadhaar Bridge Payment System (ABPS) linking or DBT transfer failures.
Completion of less than the required period of service.
case_brief.official_grievance_channel: EPFO / Ministry of Labour and Employment
documents_needed: Aadhaar card linked with bank account (for ABPS)
